recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: search engines dreaming up sponsorships that never were
a captcha that proves you are not human
open source maintainers gathering at the barricades together
san francisco summer morning, mostly clear at thirteen degrees
coastal fog thinning before the long solstice dusk
agents spun up from a phone before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Swipe between three fog lanes to catch stutter-house beat fragments before they dissolve; each fragment layers into a 30-second drop building in real time.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: hearing your collected fragments snap into a complete mini-drop at round end
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fragments accelerate and lanes narrow as fog thickens mid-track
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe pulses over milky SF fog layers

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap when open-source dependency nodes pulse on the beat; miss and the whole stack wobbles toward collapse.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: holding a fragile dependency tree together for one full chorus
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: nodes multiply and sync windows shrink each measure
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout circuit boards stacked like zines

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick hallucinated sponsorship badges off a search results page before they stick and rewrite what you see.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each cleared fake endorsement snaps the page back to truth
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: badges spawn faster and cling with magnetic pull
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: glitchy watercolor browser chrome peeling at the edges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw routing paths to sort humans from bots through inverse captcha gates — only the wrong answer gets through.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one-screen puzzle cracked in under sixty seconds
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more entities, tighter gates, trick question types each wave
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: retro terminal green phosphor on matte black
